name: Project management SaaS (partway to an ERP)

mentions.name: Project management SaaS (partway to an ERP)
mentions.description: A project management SaaS built in 2016 for the author's father's industry, about 25% of the way to an ERP tool, with a few monthly recurring accounts sold to other companies; it has improved significantly since the author started working in the industry at a company that actually uses the product.
mentions.source_excerpt: built him a project management tool about 25% of the way to an ERP tool. I've sold a few monthly recurring accounts to other companies and overall the people that like it enough to finish onboarding seem to like it.
mentions.author: minierpthrowawa
